full_text:
Banded shield

Internal ID: ShieldBanded | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Finewood x20, Iron x8 | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The Banded shield is the second round shield. It has less block power compared to Iron tower shield but can more when used to parry enemy attacks.

Notes. • When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design cannot be changed afterward.

Trivia. • The banded shield is sometimes known as "Viking Shield" in the game files.
